page.title: Pershing 46 vs Astondoa 40: Marbella Charter Boat Comparison

data.meta_description: Pershing 46 vs Astondoa 40: compare speed, space, price & capacity for your Marbella charter. Find which boat suits your group & book Puerto Banús.
data.summary: Compare the sporty Pershing 46 and the spacious Astondoa 40 for Marbella charters. Discover key differences in speed, capacity, price and onboard experience to choose your ideal boat.

faq.q: What is the main difference between the Pershing 46 and Astondoa 40?
faq.a: The Pershing 46 is a sportier, faster boat (14m, 10 pax, up to 38 knots) while the Astondoa 40 is more spacious (12.5m, 9 pax) with a focus on comfortable cruising. The Astondoa 40 is priced at Tier A rates (€749/2h), whereas the Pershing 46 requires a custom quote via WhatsApp.

faq.q: Which boat is better for a large group?
faq.a: The Pershing 46 accommodates up to 10 passengers, the Astondoa 40 up to 9. For maximum capacity, consider the Pershing. However, the Astondoa 40 offers more deck space per passenger for lounging.

faq.q: Can I charter the Pershing 46 for a half-day?
faq.a: Yes, the Pershing 46 is available for half-day charters (4 hours or more). Pricing is on request via WhatsApp, so contact us for a custom quote based on your preferred duration and itinerary.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price for these boats?
faq.a: Both charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). The Astondoa 40 also includes these at the Tier A rate.

faq.q: Which boat is faster—Pershing 46 or Astondoa 40?
faq.a: The Pershing 46 is significantly faster, with a top speed of around 38 knots, ideal for thrill-seekers. The Astondoa 40 has a more moderate cruising speed, perfect for relaxed coastal trips.

faq.q: Do both boats depart from Puerto Banús?
faq.a: Yes, both the Pershing 46 and Astondoa 40 depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's premier marina. This gives you immediate access to the Costa del Sol's best spots like Cabopino, Cala del Faro, and Estepona.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food and drinks on board?
faq.a: The charter includes drinks and light snacks, but you are welcome to bring additional food or drinks. Just check with the skipper beforehand, especially for glass bottles on the Pershing 46 due to its sportier design.

faq.q: Which boat is better for a sunset cruise?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40's spacious flybridge and aft deck make it ideal for a relaxed sunset cruise with drinks. The Pershing 46 offers a more dynamic experience, but both can anchor near Cala Cortés for stunning views.

data.body_html:
Choosing between the Pershing 46 and the Astondoa 40 for your Marbella charter comes down to speed versus space. Both boats depart from Puerto Banús and include a full package of skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. But they serve different moods: the Pershing 46 is a sporty 14-metre flybridge that hits 38 knots, while the Astondoa 40 is a beamy 12.5-metre cruiser built for lounging. Below we break down the specs, pricing, and experience so you can pick the right boat for your day on the Costa del Sol.

Pershing 46 vs Astondoa 40: Key Specs at a Glance

FeaturePershing 46Astondoa 40
Length14 m12.5 m
Max passengers109
Top speed~38 knots~28 knots
Departs fromPuerto BanúsPuerto Banús
PricingOn request (WhatsApp)Tier A: €749/2h → €2,299/8h
InclusionsSkipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, IVASkipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, IVA

The Pershing 46 is longer and faster, while the Astondoa 40 offers a wider beam and more deck space per passenger. Pricing is a major differentiator: the Astondoa 40 falls into Tier A (€749 for 2 hours, up to €2,299 for a full day), whereas the Pershing 46 requires a custom quote.

Speed and Performance

The Pershing 46 is built for adrenaline. With twin diesel engines pushing it to nearly 38 knots, it’s one of the faster options in our fleet. Perfect for a quick blast to Marbella’s Cala del Faro or a high-speed run to Estepona. The Astondoa 40 cruises comfortably at around 22–26 knots, ideal for a relaxed day with stops for swimming and sunbathing. If you want to feel the wind in your hair and cover more coastline, the Pershing wins. If you prefer a steady, social cruise, the Astondoa delivers.

Space and Comfort

The Astondoa 40’s design prioritises lounge space. Its wide aft deck and large foredeck sunpad make it a floating terrace for nine guests. The Pershing 46, while longer, has a more tapered hull and a sportier layout—still comfortable, but with less open deck area. For a group that wants to spread out, sunbathe, and dine on deck, the Astondoa 40 is the better choice. The Pershing 46 suits those who value a sleek, modern aesthetic and don’t mind a more intimate setup.

Pricing and Value

The Astondoa 40 is one of our most affordable charters at Tier A rates: €749 for 2 hours, €1,199 for 4 hours, €1,699 for 6 hours, and €2,299 for 8 hours. All include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA. The Pershing 46’s pricing is on request via WhatsApp—expect a premium for its speed and brand cachet. If you’re on a budget or want a full-day charter without surprises, the Astondoa 40 offers transparent, all-inclusive value. For a bespoke, high-performance experience, the Pershing 46 is worth the investment.

Which Boat for Which Occasion?

  • Pershing 46: Best for stag/hen parties, thrill-seekers, couples wanting a fast escape, or anyone who wants to arrive in style at Sotogrande or Cala Cortés.
  • Astondoa 40: Ideal for families, corporate groups, relaxed sunset cruises, or a full-day exploration of the Costa del Sol with stops at Cabopino and Marbella Marina.

Onboard Experience: Drinks, Snacks, and Skipper

Both charters include a licensed skipper who knows the best anchorages—from the quiet coves near La Concha to the lively beach clubs of Puerto Banús. You’ll get water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. The Astondoa 40’s larger cockpit table makes it easier to serve a group meal, while the Pershing 46’s sportier layout is better for a quick toast before heading out. Neither boat allows glass bottles on deck for safety, but plastic cups are provided.

Booking and Availability

Both boats are available for charter from Puerto Banús. The Astondoa 40 can be booked directly at Tier A rates online. For the Pershing 46, contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote and availability. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during peak season (June–September). Late availability may exist for same-day bookings—just ask.
